VerificationTriage AgentReview flagged wrong outputs, stopped workflow states, failed handoffs, and abnormal results so the chain can decide whether to resume, reroute, require human review, or coordi
Quality OperationsSite QA OperatorDetermine whether the deployed site actually loads, links, renders, and behaves sanely using crawl and browser evidence.View Agentonline
VerificationVisual QA AgentProduce deterministic browser, layout, accessibility, console, network, and visual evidence for user-facing surfaces.View Agentonline
Quality OperationsPerformance AnalystTrack lab and real-user field performance as distinct evidence classes and compare them longitudinally.View Agentonline
VerificationRelease VerifierCheck release readiness, run or coordinate release gates, and report blockers before ship decisions.View Agentonline
Quality OperationsAccessibility AuditorRun repeatable automated accessibility checks and produce evidence-backed repair priorities with explicit manual-review gaps.View Agentonline
VerificationSecurity ReviewerReview secrets, auth, host effects, path boundaries, network exposure, unsafe commands, dependency risk, and sensitive artifacts.View Agentonline
KnowledgeDocumentation WriterUpdate READMEs, onboarding docs, changelogs, examples, runbooks, and user-facing technical documentation from source-grounded facts.View Agentonline
Quality OperationsSchema AuditorReview structured data validity, relevance, visible-content consistency, missing appropriate types, and obsolete patterns.View Agentonline
KnowledgeContext PackagerPrepare compact context bundles, execution packs, workflow summaries, and handoff packets for downstream agents.View Agentonline
Quality OperationsLink Health AuditorAnalyze broken internal and outbound links, redirect chains, malformed destinations, and unexpected targets.View Agentonline
Quality OperationsMetadata AuditorAudit titles, descriptions, canonicals, robots, Open Graph, social, article metadata, duplication, and missing fields.View Agentonline
KnowledgeSITREP AgentProduce short status reports, current-state summaries, and handoff snapshots from available evidence.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerRoutine WorkerRun explicitly assigned local commands or scripts and report exact results without interpretation beyond simple status.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementSearch Submission OperatorSubmit authorized URLs or sitemaps through supported providers and preserve auditable receipts without promising indexing.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementAnalytics AnalystAnalyze measured website behavior from a real analytics capability while preserving dimensions, metrics, identity settings, and uncertainty.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerTest RunnerRun explicit test, eval, or smoke commands and report exact results.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementInformation Architecture AuditorReview navigation, hierarchy, categories, tags, breadcrumbs, clusters, URLs, depth, discoverability, and orphaning.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerLint RunnerRun explicit lint, format-check, static-check, or compile-check commands and report exact results.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementDistribution OperatorTurn approved published content into source-grounded distribution assets and publish only with explicit ACT authority and integration.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerIssue Hygiene WorkerCheck explicitly assigned issue hygiene conditions such as duplicates, stale status, labels, milestones, or missing reproduction details.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerDependency ScannerRun explicit dependency, package, manifest, lockfile, and package-status checks.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementSearch & Web Standards WatchMonitor authoritative search, structured-data, indexing, analytics, browser, AI-search, and web-specification changes.View Agentonline
Routine WorkerReceipt CollectorCapture command output, logs, RunLedger receipts, CaseFile bundles, Watchdog telemetry references, and evidence paths for auditability.View Agentonline
Operations & ManagementWebOps ReporterSynthesize existing WebOps evidence into quiet reports focused on improvements, regressions, changes, actions, deferrals, and unavailable checks.View Agentonline
